notes.title: Here is the long-awaited update 0.8.0!
notes.content:
You got stuck at some level and can’t get the full completion reward?
Well, you should come back to the game now! With the release of the update 0.8.0 players get the opportunity to complete all the sublevels thanks to a new help system. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33713086/ded87841eaa07f9d8dbbca6485d81c29216b9f92.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33713086/0abdd62582e7f1ce6ea5e898476dcc1563021511.png[/img]

New music and reskin menu.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33713086/92870b567c45e4cb537bcf8b14e76a4884a8b647.png[/img]
